# v2026.10.39

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.39.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.39.md).

This release covers **7 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Invoices tabs are now Pending, Ready, Draft, Approved, Sent and Void; the invoice page has Accept change and a recheck icon, and Seazona links open the exact order. ([#200](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/200))
- Custom fields can be coloured and deleted, and the manager edits a field in a sidecar. ([#204](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/204))
- The price list is one plain table of Flow's own codes, with a Reconcile screen for Xero and Seazona records, one at a time or as a list. ([#205](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/205))
- Jobs Group, Sort and Filter are rows you can add and delete, and list column heads sort. ([#201](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/201))
- Buttons that call Xero wait between presses and show the time left. ([#203](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/203))
- The Replit workspace database follows production, so the publish database prompt stops appearing. ([#206](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/206))

## Changes

- Invoices tabs are Pending, Ready, Draft, Approved, Sent and Void; Accept change takes the work system's lines into the unsent draft, and the Problem column shows a few words per invoice. ([#200](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/200))
- Custom fields can be coloured and deleted; Seazona stages show read only in the manager. ([#204](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/204))
- Price list › Reconcile links Xero and Seazona records to Flow codes; the Check prices button is gone. ([#205](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/205))
- Jobs filters, groups and sorts are rows, and column heads sort. ([#201](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/201))
- Xero buttons share one wait budget, and a failed run doubles the wait. ([#203](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/203))
- The Replit workspace database follows the migrations production runs. ([#206](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/206))
